import numpy as np
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeRegressor, DecisionTreeClassifier

# Helper: extract impurity values for single-sample leaves
def single_sample_leaf_indices(tree):
    children_left = tree.tree_.children_left
    children_right = tree.tree_.children_right
    is_leaf = (children_left == -1) & (children_right == -1)
    single = (tree.tree_.n_node_samples == 1)
    return np.flatnonzero(is_leaf & single)

results = {}

# 1) Regression toy with all-missing pair at start (from report)
X = np.array([np.nan, np.nan, 3, 4, 5, 6], dtype=float).reshape(-1, 1)
y = np.arange(6)
reg = DecisionTreeRegressor(random_state=0)
reg.fit(X, y)
idx = single_sample_leaf_indices(reg)
imp = reg.tree_.impurity[idx]
results['reg_toy_single_leaf_impurity'] = imp
results['reg_toy_single_leaf_all_finite'] = np.all(np.isfinite(imp)) if imp.size else True
results['reg_toy_single_leaf_all_nonneg'] = np.all(imp >= -1e-12) if imp.size else True
results['reg_toy_single_leaf_max_abs'] = float(np.max(np.abs(imp))) if imp.size else 0.0

# 2) Classification toy on iris with NaNs (approximate construction from report)
from sklearn import datasets
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

X, y = datasets.load_iris(return_X_y=True)
rng = np.random.RandomState(42)
# mask shape (n_samples, 1) based on 4 features -> uses only feature 2 proportion (report has X[:,[2]]/8)
# We'll follow report literally: mask sampled with p = X[:,[2]]/8
p = (X[:, [2]] / 8.0)
mask = rng.binomial(n=np.ones((1,4), dtype=np.int32), p=p.T).T.astype(bool)  # may produce Nx1
X_missing = X.copy()
# Ensure mask is (n_samples,)
mask_flat = mask.reshape(-1)
X_missing[mask_flat, :] = np.nan
X_train, _, y_train, _ = train_test_split(X_missing, y, random_state=13)

clf = DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=3, max_features='sqrt', random_state=1857819720)
clf.fit(X_train, y_train)
idx = single_sample_leaf_indices(clf)
imp = clf.tree_.impurity[idx]
results['cls_toy_single_leaf_impurity'] = imp
results['cls_toy_single_leaf_all_finite'] = np.all(np.isfinite(imp)) if imp.size else True
results['cls_toy_single_leaf_all_nonneg'] = np.all(imp >= -1e-12) if imp.size else True
results['cls_toy_single_leaf_max_abs'] = float(np.max(np.abs(imp))) if imp.size else 0.0

# 3) Reduce to a single representative summary for quick defect signal
# If any single-sample leaf impurity is non-finite or negative or max_abs > 1e-9, record defect flag.

defect = False
for key in ['reg_toy_single_leaf_impurity', 'cls_toy_single_leaf_impurity']:
    arr = results[key]
    if arr.size:
        if (not np.all(np.isfinite(arr))) or np.any(arr < -1e-12) or np.max(np.abs(arr)) > 1e-9:
            defect = True
results['defect_flag'] = defect

for k,v in results.items():
    # probe contract: record at least one scalar via numeric values; arrays are okay but keep them small
    if isinstance(v, np.ndarray):
        # record summary statistics plus first few values
        if v.size:
            probe_name = k
            probe(v[:10])
        else:
            probe( np.array([], dtype=float) )
    else:
        probe(k, v)
